operations.title: The resolved normal Jacobian cancels the Cayley-Menger density pole and the first correction adds no finite exceptional-ratio puncture
operations.description: On A-B=u xi, the scalar A.12 determinant quotient has normal order -1 while d(A-B)=u dxi gives the relative current order zero. The O(u) correction is polynomial in t and has only the t-independent denominator Phi.
